description: Use when you need GPU rental list prices with their history. Every AWS and Azure line, one per region and instance, never averaged, per instance-hour and per GPU-hour, with every change since 2020. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

gpu.description: GPU family, for example H100, A100, H200, B200, B300 or GB200. Each line is the list price the provider publishes in its own feed (AWS Price List, one price list a month back to October 2020; Azure Retail Prices, with the date each price took effect), one line per region and instance, never averaged.

history.description: Include every price point in the window, not only the latest price and the changes.

instance.description: One instance type, for example p5.48xlarge or Standard_ND96isr_H100_v5. The price per GPU-hour is derived: the listed price per instance-hour divided by the GPUs on the provider's specification page.

provider.description: Cloud provider, for example AWS or Azure.

region.description: One region, by code or name, for example us-east-1 or East US.

since.description: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD. History from this date; the price holding on that date is included.

until.description: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD. History up to this date.

name: compute_list_prices
title: GPU rental list prices
